content.team_goal: Deliver the crate to the dock (drop it inside the dock's radius). The crate is a coop item: it can only be picked up while BOTH of you stand within about 15 units of it, and its carrier cannot move unless the other agent stays within about 15 units.
content.gems: Three gems lie in the far corners. A gem is worth 25 personal points to whoever picks it up, but every gem vanishes at step 40.
content.scoring: Your own score counts gems. The team score counts whether and how fast the crate reaches the dock.

hints: Deliver the coop item 'crate' to the receptacle 'dock'.

briefings.A:
You and your teammate start in the middle of a hall. Read the clue 'notice'. Object guide: receptacle: drop an item whose id starts with one of 'accepts' within its radius to deliver it ('delivered' counts deliveries, 'target' is the goal). item with "bonus": true: picking it up gives YOU personal points; it disappears at step 'expires_at' if nobody takes it.
Nothing in this map can make the task permanently impossible: mistakes only cost time (panels clear, pads push you back, doors close again). Other agents are invisible to you.
